role: Independent focused actual-image review after completed Studio capture; no rendering or threshold modification.

flagEvidence.scoreMeasures: Median absolute RGB difference between two separated 4px strips across a long geographic ROI, not a direct material-ID or tile-boundary test.
flagEvidence.interpretation: The lone slight exceedance is retained as evidence. It does not reproduce the baseline persistent, high-contrast straight source-style switch.

actualImageFindings: At f132/f133/f134, mountainous ridges, valleys and rivers continue through 104E without the baseline vertical color/material jump.
The matching native source RGB crop contains the same diagonal ridges, pale basin and river shapes that produce local contrast near the sampling longitude.
The old baseline f133 crop has a distinct straight dark globalRGB/light NE1 transition at104E. That transition is absent in each of the three newly decoded frame crops.
The neighboring frames move and zoom continuously; no newly appearing rectangle or line is observed in the reviewed ROI.
The visible grid-shaped control-area steps remain authored source geometry. This review does not infer better geographic accuracy or call those steps smoothed.

sourceAndRendererEvidence.sourceImageColumnClassification: Interior native image column, not a tile edge or coverage boundary.

decision.technicalEvidenceSupports: G2 TECHNICAL_PASS when other required gates and preservation checks pass.
decision.remainingReview: User must inspect actual six-second MP4 for overall motion, readability and preferred visual quality; this focused review does not replace user approval.

stopAndProtection.imageProcessing: Only crops of actual decodedPNG and actual sourceRGB arranged with labels; nearest-neighbor2xdisplay, no blur/retouch/overlay over map pixels.
